provenance.tokens-only-caveat: menu/ is REAL, live component source (menu.ts, menu-item.ts, sub-menu.ts) — confirmed by `find`, a genuine third outcome after checkbox/switch/radio-group/slider's 'real' and toast/snackbar's 'tokens-only' (DROPDOWN-MENU-MATRIX.md §0). Structure/behaviour rows are therefore [S] from the .ts files themselves, not [R]-by-absence the way most M3 columns' behaviour rows have been.
provenance.edition-gap-and-its-resolution: versions/v0_192/ has _md-comp-menu.scss (container only) but NO _md-comp-menu-item.scss — confirmed by `find`, not an empty grep. The UNVERSIONED tokens/_md-comp-menu-item.scss derives item values by merging menu.values() with md-comp-list-item.values(), stripping the 'list-item-' prefix — and that list-item function itself hardcodes `@use 'versions/v0_192/md-comp-list'` as its ONLY dependency, plus two bare literals (top-space/bottom-space: 12px, container-color: transparent) that are edition-independent by construction. Every menu-item value below is therefore a real, TRACEABLE v0.192 number, cited to both files — treated as an [S] derivation per rule 6, not a declared gap. See DROPDOWN-MENU-MATRIX.md §0 finding 3.
provenance.trigger-*: tokens/versions/v0_192/_md-comp-standard-menu-button.scss (REAL, present in the pinned edition, unlike menu-item) — the unfilled/text variant, matching Salt's default transparent-appearance trigger. label-text-color -> on-surface-variant -> #49454f/#cac4d0. hover-state-layer-color/-opacity -> on-surface-variant / md-sys-state.hover-state-layer-opacity=0.08 (v0.192). focus-/pressed-state-layer-opacity both -> 0.12 (v0.192, versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss — the SAME edition-pinned 0.08/0.12/0.12 triple docs/foundations/state-layers.md now records as edition-dependent). disabled-label-text-opacity -> 0.38. CONFIRMED ABSENT: no container-color/background token of any kind in this file, no padding/leading-space token either — an unfilled TEXT-style trigger, not a filled/outlined one.
provenance.trigger-shape: container-shape -> md-sys-shape.corner-full = 9999px, a fully pill trigger — the SAME role badge/chip's own corner-full already resolved.
provenance.trigger-open-off: CONFIRMED ABSENT — the token file's own families are hover/focus/pressed/disabled ONLY; no distinct 'open'/'expanded' state-layer family exists to alias, unlike Salt's (dead-reference) attempt at one.
provenance.popup-bg: menu-container-color -> md-sys-color.surface-container -> neutral94 #f3edf7 light / neutral12 #211f26 dark (versions/v0_192/_md-comp-menu.scss, reused verbatim from select.m3.json's own identical slot).
provenance.popup-shadow: container-elevation -> level2, this registry's own canonical dp->CSS derivation (docs/foundations/elevation.md): 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 2px 6px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15).
provenance.popup-shape: container-shape -> corner-extra-small = 4px, the SAME role select's own menu-popup shape already resolved.
provenance.popup-border-off: CONFIRMED ABSENT — internal/_menu.scss `.menu { border: none }`, elevation/shadow only.
provenance.popup-padding-gap-off: CONFIRMED ABSENT at the container level — internal/_menu.scss's `.items`/`.menu` rules carry no padding or gap property; vertical space is entirely per-item (see item-padding), and there is no horizontal container inset at all (items span the full popup width).
provenance.popup-zindex: internal/_menu.scss `.menu { z-index: 20 }` — a literal, the lowest of the three columns' popup z-index values.
provenance.item-fg: the v0.192 derivation's own renamed 'label-text-color' -> list-item-label-text-color -> md-sys-color.on-surface -> #1d1b20 light / #e6e0e9 dark.
provenance.item-font: renamed 'label-text-*' -> list-item-label-text-* -> md-sys-typescale.body-large = 1rem/1.5rem, weight-regular 400, Roboto (self-hosted, this pipeline's standing M3 precedent).
provenance.item-bg-off: the derivation function EXPLICITLY sets container-color to transparent ('menu items use their parent menu for their container colour... we change its default unselected background colour to transparent to inherit from its parent menu') — a real, sourced, DELIBERATE off, not an oversight.
provenance.item-padding: renamed top-space/bottom-space -> 12px each (edition-independent hardcoded literal in the unversioned derivation function) + renamed leading-space/trailing-space -> list-item-leading-space/-trailing-space -> versions/v0_192/_md-comp-list.scss = 16px each.
provenance.item-gap: menu-item.ts's own :host rule: `gap: 16px` — a literal in the component's own SCSS mixin file (internal/menuitem/_menu-item.scss), not a versioned token.
provenance.item-shape: menu-item.ts's own :host rule: `border-radius: inherit` from the popup's own container-shape = corner-extra-small = 4px.
provenance.item-layer (hover/focus): renamed hover-/focus-state-layer-color -> list-item-hover-/-focus-state-layer-color -> on-surface -> #1d1b20/#e6e0e9, at hover-state-layer-opacity 0.08 / focus-state-layer-opacity 0.12 (v0.192 — CHANGED from 0.10 under latest, per select.m3.json's own already-recorded finding).
provenance.item-disabled-opacity: renamed disabled-opacity -> list-item-disabled-label-text-opacity -> 0.3 (v0.192 — CHANGED from 0.38 under latest, same re-point select.m3.json already recorded).
provenance.item-icon-fg: renamed leading-icon-color -> list-item-leading-icon-color -> on-surface-variant -> #49454f/#cac4d0. No dedicated icon-SIZE token exists for menu-item (grepped, absent from the supported-tokens list) — 24px used as [R], Material's own default md-icon size, the same convention select.m3.json's own leading-icon-size 24px cell used at the same role.
provenance.item-open-bg: the STANDALONE versions/v0_192/_md-comp-menu.scss's own list-item-selected-container-color -> md-sys-color.secondary-container -> #e8def8 light / #4a4458 dark (the SAME slot/value chip.m3.json's own chip-bg-selected already resolved) — a DIFFERENT slot from plain hover/focus, unlike shadcn which reuses its own hover slot for the open state.
provenance.shortcut-*: renamed trailing-supporting-text-* -> list-item-trailing-supporting-text-* -> versions/v0_192/_md-comp-list.scss: color -> on-surface-variant, font -> label-small = 0.6875rem/1rem, weight-medium 500, Roboto (versions/v0_192/_md-ref-typeface.scss carries the literal family — docs/foundations/typography.md's own correction).
provenance.separator-off-color: no dedicated separator colour token in menu/item files — internal/_menu.scss's own `::slotted(:is(md-divider,[role='separator'])) { margin: 8px 0 }` styles ANY slotted divider generically by MARGIN only, no colour; the slotted element's own default colour applies, [R].
